meaning: Each fighter's intended signature strengths. Taken from its design doc where one exists; drafted from its docs/design/roster.md entry otherwise (drafted: true, for Tom to confirm). kill: main KO direction; edgeGuard: off-stage power; recovery: how hard it is to edge-guard; range: the spacing it is strongest at.

Air-speed rushdown chasing with glaives; down air spike; glide drifting band; Wing Ascent covers high

Grounded heavy, axe-tip spacing, Storm Bolt cover; back air finisher; heavy exposed recovery band
Precision mobility and edge pressure, light body; Blink may pass main-deck edge

Heavy hammer; Beacon Strike up smash, Cleansing Hammer bonks upward; Ascension falls helpless
